text:
tori: hi team, trying the node quickstart from a repo template. first request returns 402 even though billing shows active in the console. using a CI service account token. any ideas?

 tori: curl i used: ```bash
 curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
   -H 'Authorization: Bearer SA-OLD-TOKEN' \
   -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
   -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'
 ```

 tori: response header: HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required and body {"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace_billing_not_active"}

 devon_devex: thanks. quick checklist: 1) which workspace does that SA belong to? 2) did you join via invite or create the workspace yourself? 3) was the SA created inside the workspace org or in a personal org?

 tori: i think the SA was minted by our infra engineer in their personal account earlier, then shared into the repo. workspace id is org-green-91 and console shows billing Active.

 devon_devex: that explains it. tokens created outside the workspace won't be mapped to the tenant until a token bound to the workspace is used or the token is recreated within that org. edge layer will return 402/403 while mapping/billing handshake completes.

 tori: hmm, we can't log into the console from CI to generate a new token. is there a way to trigger tenant mapping from the maintainers?

 billing-bot: you can run `@billing-bot refresh org-green-91` to force tenant cache invalidation. note: mapping tokens to tenants requires a token created in the same org; regenerating the SA in the workspace or creating a workspace-scoped key is required. propagation ~30-90s.

 tori: i did @billing-bot refresh org-green-91 and updated the RW_KEY secret in the pipeline with a newly created SA token (created by a teammate inside org-green-91). started a new pipeline run to ensure env picks up the new value.

 mike_sre: common CI pitfall: runners sometimes reuse cached secrets or env images. ensure the job spins up a fresh runner or prints process.env.RW_KEY to confirm.

 tori: good catch. i added a debug echo in the job to print the prefix of the key and confirmed the new token is present. retried after ~45s and got: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden with body {"code":"forbidden","message":"tenant_mapping_pending"}

 devon_devex: proxy fallback behavior — you may see 403 while mapping is still rolling through caches, then 402 if billing flag not fully set, then 200 once everything aligns. looks like you're in the middle of mapping. give it another 30s and retry.

 tori: retried ~40s later and got 200 OK with generated text "hello from quickstart". first successful call from CI: :tada: 

 devon_devex: great! follow-ups: 1) quickstart docs: add a note for invite/CI flows (create SA inside workspace, add card if invite-only, run @billing-bot refresh), 2) SDK: surface the original http response body on non-2xx as `rawBody` to make debugging easier, 3) console: consider a button for owners to provision trial credits for invite orgs and a one-click tenant refresh.

 mike_sre: adding SDK and console todos. small DX win to reduce these repetitive threads.

 tori: thanks everyone, closing this thread. :thumbsup:
